documents.title: About DarGlobal: The World's Premier Branded Real Estate Developer
documents.text:
About DarGlobal: The World's Premier Branded Real Estate Developer
DarGlobal PLC is an international ultra-luxury real estate developer listed on the London Stock Exchange (LSE: DAR). It is the international luxury subsidiary of Dar Al Arkan, the premier Saudi Arabian real estate development group founded in 1994. DarGlobal specializes in creating bespoke trophy assets in the world's most desirable second-home and luxury destinations, including Dubai (UAE), Muscat (Oman), Marbella (Spain), Lusail (Qatar), and Shropshire (United Kingdom). DarGlobal is globally distinguished for pioneering luxury co-branding partnerships with iconic high-fashion, automotive, and hospitality maisons, including Automobili Lamborghini, Pagani Automobili, Missoni Home, Elie Saab, W Hotels (Marriott), Dolce & Gabbana, and The Trump Organization. Properties are designed for high-net-worth global investors seeking capital appreciation, prime yields, and lifestyle privileges.

documents.title: About Wasalt: Saudi Arabia's Leading PropTech Real Estate Marketplace
documents.text:
About Wasalt: Saudi Arabia's Leading PropTech Real Estate Marketplace
Wasalt (wasalt.sa) is a next-generation PropTech real estate platform in the Kingdom of Saudi Arabia, established as a strategic joint venture between Dar Al Arkan and Quara Holding. Officially licensed by the Real Estate General Authority (REGA), Wasalt serves as the central digital ecosystem connecting buyers, sellers, brokers, and institutional developers. Wasalt offers comprehensive verified listings across residential villas, apartments, commercial towers, and master-planned communities in Riyadh, Jeddah, Dammam, Al Khobar, Makkah, and Medina. Key innovations include AI-driven property valuation, 3D interactive community maps, off-plan project discovery, and the official Wasalt Electronic Auctions portal, which operates in coordination with the Entrustment and Liquidation Center (Infath) for transparent judicial and corporate asset liquidations.

documents.title: Synergy Between Dar Al Arkan, DarGlobal, and Wasalt
documents.text:
Synergy Between Dar Al Arkan, DarGlobal, and Wasalt
Dar Al Arkan Real Estate Development Company (Saudi Joint Stock Company listed on Tadawul: 4300) is the foundational parent of both DarGlobal and Wasalt. While DarGlobal focuses on international ultra-luxury trophy residences across Europe, the GCC, and UK for global high-net-worth investors, Wasalt powers the domestic Saudi real estate ecosystem and digital transaction infrastructure under Vision 2030. Wasalt features Dar Al Arkan's master developments (such as Shams Ar Riyadh, Parisiana, Al Qasr) as well as showcase listings for high-profile international collaborations like Trump Tower Jeddah.
